scope: Depth-ladder Head-directed support policy. D0 establishes the generated-design reward lineage; D1+ uses strict incumbent improvement. WT/native is safety and local-attribution reference only.

depth0_reward_bootstrap.candidate_domain: Exact definitively feasible sequence-equivalence representatives from the generated D0 pool.
depth0_reward_bootstrap.runtime_binding: The cycle supplies source depth, selected rank, and selected endpoint id directly to the policy call.
depth0_reward_bootstrap.fallback: none; a missing or mismatched rank-zero binding stalls
depth0_reward_bootstrap.commit_law: Only a committed D0 transition binds the selected donor as I1.

reference_roles.cumulative_safety_reference: Immutable WT/native sequence used by cumulative safety admission.
reference_roles.depth0_attribution_reference: The same content-bound WT/native bytes used only for D0 aligned-window direction and leave-one-out revert residues.
reference_roles.lineage_reward_incumbent: Absent logically at D0; I1 is the committed rank-zero D0 donor; later Id is the last accepted endpoint.

write_law.candidate_domain: editable non-anchor positions unresolved in the live source, comparator-discordant, and covered by an aligned Head window improved in the donor
write_law.contribution: R_H(donor with position reverted to the active comparator) - R_H(donor)
write_law.positive_gate: strictly greater than the calibrated local-contribution tolerance

reopen_law.target: content-bound midpoint_tie_low centre of the exact schedule band

artifact_contract.required_fields: reward_gate_kind and attribution_reference_sequence_md5; donor-gate fields are null at D0

not_authorized: WT-as-reward-incumbent at D0, a D0 epsilon comparison, endpoint_rank > 0 bootstrap, or weakening the strict D1+ margin.
